title: Qualify 363 original artifacts and complete the opening grid
description: Use the historical project's own Spotless check skip property to avoid running a code-style plugin against the JDK 21 compiler ABI during the original reactor build. Capture all four public claims on the frozen opening fingerprint and verify raw JVM outcomes.

steps.name: Build unchanged artifacts and run the original regression
steps.run: export TMPDIR="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/tmp"; repos=(); if test -d "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/ci-sources/java-domain-proof/parquet-java"; then repos=(--repos "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/ci-sources/java-domain-proof"); fi; python3 -B lib/benchmark/organic-java/upstream.py 363 --cases lib/benchmark/java-domain-proof/cases.json "${repos[@]}" --maven-cache "${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/in-the-loop/external-upgrades/maven" --output examples/363-parquet-nested-binary/records/qualified-build

steps.name: Measure four ordinary native claims and their finite JVM grid
